from runtime_sdk import NodeContext


def run(ctx: NodeContext):
    """入口：把用户输入交给下游。"""
    text = ctx.text.strip()
    if not text:
        raise ValueError("输入为空，请先在运行面板填写输入")
    ctx.log(f"收到输入：{len(text)} 字")
    return text

LLM_3_PROMPT = ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages([
    ("system", "一次大模型调用，最基础的推理单元。"),
    ("human", "{input}"),
])

def llm_3(state: AgentState) -> dict:
    """LLM 节点"""
    model = _active_llm().bind(temperature=0.3)
    text = _stream(model, LLM_3_PROMPT.format_messages(input=state.get("data", "")),
                   "n3", "llm_3")
    return {"data": text}

data.label: 条件分支
data.name: condition_4
data.description: 用表达式判定 true/false 两条出边。
data.code:
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 节点：条件分支  (condition_4)  类型：condition
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def condition_4(state: AgentState) -> dict:
    """条件分支 —— 按判别问题决定走 true 还是 false。"""
    text = str(state.get("data", ""))
    question = "len(state.get('context') or '') > 0"
    verdict = _active_llm().bind(temperature=0).invoke([
        {"role": "system", "content": "你只输出 true 或 false，不要解释。"},
        {"role": "user", "content": f"判别问题：{question}\n\n待判内容：\n{text}\n\n只回答 true 或 false。"},
    ]).content.strip().lower()
    branch = "true" if verdict.startswith("true") else "false"
    rounds = int(state.get("loop_count") or 0) + 1
    max_loops = 4
    if rounds > max_loops and branch != "false":
        branch = "false"
        _emit({"event": "log", "level": "warn", "node": "n4", "name": "condition_4",
               "message": f"已到循环上限 {max_loops} 次，强制走出口"})
    _emit({"event": "route", "node": "n4", "name": "condition_4",
           "branch": branch, "reason": _brief(verdict, 120)})
    return {"data": text, "route": branch, "loop_count": rounds}
data.preview_code:
from runtime_sdk import NodeContext


def run(ctx: NodeContext):
    """条件判断：返回 "true" 或 "false"。"""
    expr = ctx.params.get("expr", "len(ctx.text) > 0")
    try:
        ok = bool(eval(expr, {"__builtins__": {}}, {"ctx": ctx, "text": ctx.text}))
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        ctx.log(f"条件求值失败，默认走 false：{exc}")
        ok = False
    return "true" if ok else "false"

from runtime_sdk import NodeContext


def run(ctx: NodeContext):
    """出口：终止流程并返回最终答案给用户。"""
    source = ctx.params.get("source", "auto")
    answer = ctx.text
    if source in ("auto", "agent"):
        # auto：链路里出现过 agent 就优先返回它的回答，避免被下游格式化节点覆盖
        answer = ctx.state.get("answer") or ctx.text
    ctx.emit("final", {"answer": answer})
    return answer
